scope: Finite-N=6 static local Floquet-manifold benchmark under the same common physical product preparation as Gate A v2. This is a test of a preparation-compatible reduction, not a claim of a universal effective theory.

fixed_preparation.reduced_initial_state: Project the fixed chain product state into the declared K-state Floquet subspace and normalize by p_K=Tr(P_K rho_chain(0)); declare undefined if p_K<=1e-12.

common_channel_construction.local_near_pi_pair: Among a<b with circular pi mismatch <=0.02 rad, select max(max(|B0_ab|,|B0_ba|)). This pair is used only to define a local mechanism anchor, never the full-model initial state.
common_channel_construction.initial_support_order: Sort all Floquet states by descending |<phi_a|up_z^{tensor N}>|^2; exact ties are resolved by ascending numerical Schur index.
common_channel_construction.hybrid_order: Start with the selected local near-pi pair, then append initial-support-ranked states excluding already selected entries until K states are present.
common_channel_construction.index_disclaimer: All numerical Floquet indices are backend-specific Schur ordering metadata, not physical labels.

purpose.legacy_resonance_ranked: records the failure of the existing local-pair mechanism under the common preparation
purpose.initial_support_ranked: tests whether preparation support alone accounts for the full response
purpose.hybrid_pair_plus_initial_support: tests whether local near-pi channels add predictive value once physical initial support is included

fixed_static_reduction.Hamiltonian: H_K=diag(eps_a-mean(eps_K)) tensor I_d -(omega_d/2) I_K tensor Z_d + g[(B_K^(0))^dagger tensor sigma_d^- + B_K^(0) tensor sigma_d^+]
fixed_static_reduction.readout: Same 80-period, four-samples-per-half-step, 20-period-discard Omega/2 phasor used by the linked full-model source JSON.

for_each_of_production_and_heldout: hybrid epsilon_spec(K=16) <= 0.60 * legacy epsilon_spec(K=4), provided the legacy value is defined
hybrid raw peak ratio(K=16) is in [0.50, 2.00]
prospective_success_rule.interpretation_if_pass: The data support a finite-system, preparation-compatible extended manifold at the declared K scale. They do not establish asymptotic convergence or universality.
prospective_success_rule.interpretation_if_fail: The current static B^(0)-only local Floquet reduction remains inadequate for the common physical preparation; do not pursue larger N. Proceed instead to the small-N micromotion/Sambe feasibility route.

provenance_requirements.before_run: Commit this protocol and the executable benchmark script to the public repository; record protocol/script SHA-256, source-result SHA-256 and Git commit in every result JSON.
provenance_requirements.manuscript_language: prospectively frozen numerical protocol; not preregistration absent a separate external timestamp.
